messages:
dylan-recruiter: Morning — two interviewers say scorecards are read-only and can't submit. Candidates now show pending feedback. Anyone else?

tess-ops: I saw it for a panel at 9:10. UI shows "embedded scorecard (view only)". Tried re-sending link, still read-only.

ryan-eng: Looking at last night's permissions-sync. Migration consolidated role flags and dropped the embedded write bit for roles with legacy=true. That would cause view-only embedded widgets.

dylan-recruiter: Affected interview IDs: 4120, 4121. Both contractor interviewers.

ella-hr: We need a fast workaround to capture feedback if UI blocks submission.

tess-ops: For now, ask interviewers to DM their notes to the recruiter. I'll paste into the scorecard and mark "feedback-captured".

ryan-eng: Plan: hotfix migration to restore `interviewer_embedded_write` for legacy roles, add check in sync job, and backfill affected users. Deploying hotfix to staging now.

deploy-bot: deployment permissions-sync v1.9.1-hotfix started by ryan-eng  staging

ryan-eng: Hotfix on staging looks good. Tess, can you test submitting on staging?

tess-ops: Staging test pass. Queuing backfill for prod. Job 5802 ETA 8m.

ella-hr: Please add a KB note with the DM workaround and steps to mark "feedback-captured". Also request an audit for the last 7 days.

dylan-recruiter: Thanks everyone — will notify hiring teams when backfill completes. :thumbsup:
